practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Prioritization of Test Case Design
practices_evaluation.justification: The test includes Given-When-Then comments indicating BDD-style structuring and design intent, suggesting some thoughtful design rather than purely ad-hoc creation.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Responsible Addition of Test Code Maintenance
practices_evaluation.justification: The test directly manipulates internal fields (grafo1.cab = grafo0.prox), coupling the test to implementation details rather than using only public APIs; this makes the test brittle to internal refactors.
Assertions are specific (assertEquals with expected values) and include descriptive failure messages; multiple specific assertions are used rather than generic assertTrue only.
The test contains concise Given-When-Then comments that explain the intent rather than commenting trivial operations; comments are minimal and helpful.
The test contains no sources of non-determinism (no Random, no time-based calls, no Thread.sleep) and uses local state, so results should be deterministic.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects
practices_evaluation.justification: The test operates on local Grafo instances and does not persist external resources or modify global/static state; no cleanup is required.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories
practices_evaluation.justification: The class is annotated with @Category(UnitTest.class), providing a label for selective execution and classification of the test.
